audit_result.proof_trace: The middleware guards all non-public paths by checking only whether the `oauth_user_id` and `oauth_access_token` cookies are truthy (`if (oauthUserId && oauthToken)`), never verifying their cryptographic validity or performing any server-side session lookup. An HTTP client can send arbitrary non-empty values for these cookies to satisfy the check and receive `NextResponse.next()`. The `/api/admin/force-logout-all` route has no independent auth check beyond this middleware gate, so unauthenticated attackers who forge the cookies can call it directly.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An attacker sends `curl -H 'Cookie: oauth_user_id=x; oauth_access_token=y' https://<app>/api/admin/force-logout-all` between 22:50–23:50 JST; the middleware accepts the forged cookies, the route's only guard (a time-window check) passes, and `forceLogoutAll()` is executed — forcibly terminating all active user sessions.

PROP-attendanceze-inv-025.text: Protected routes must redirect unauthenticated requests to /login, never serve protected content.
